system.description: If you are wielding two Pistols and make a single ranged attack with one of those Pistols as a Standard Action, even if you miss you deal damage equal to half your Heroic Level to the target. This consumes a single shot from the weapon not making the attack, and the weapon you attack with uses as many shots required by the attack.

holocron.sourceBook: Star Wars Saga Edition Scum and Villainy
